name: Choice Cards
hint: Pick a card. Try arrow keys. Switch to multiple.
description: Radio cards (pick one) or checkbox cards (pick many) on native inputs, so keyboard, screen readers and forms behave natively. Each group is one Tab stop; arrow keys move between cards. The chosen card lifts and its check draws in.
intents: pick one of several options shown as cards
usage: Use when options need a sentence of explanation (plans, roles, delivery methods). For short labels use a plain radio group or segmented control. 2–6 options. Pass `items`, a `legend` (or `aria-label`), and `value` + `onChange` (or `defaultValue`). In a <form> give it a `name` so the chosen value is submitted; `required` and `error` work like a text field's. Cards fill the width they are given (up to 640px; override with style={{ maxWidth }}), `columns` is the most per row and they wrap on narrow screens. With no items it renders nothing. To send focus back to the group (after a validation error), call `ref.current.focus()`: it lands on the checked card, else the first enabled one. `metaFont="text"` sets the meta line in the body font.

keyboard.does: Moves to the checked card, or the first enabled one; the cards are one stop.
Moves to the next enabled card and chooses it, wrapping from the last to the first.
Moves to the previous enabled card and chooses it, wrapping from the first to the last.
Moves focus to the next or previous enabled card without changing it, wrapping at the ends.
Moves focus to the first or last enabled card.
Checks or unchecks the focused card.

screenReader: A group named by `legend`. Each card is a radio (single mode) or a checkbox (multiple mode) named by its `title`, with its `description` and `meta` read after it, and says whether it is checked as it changes. With `error` every card is marked invalid and the message is read as the group's description.

dataProps.type: Array<{ value: string; title: node; description?: node; meta?: node; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean }>
dataProps.description: The cards: [{ value, title, description?, meta?, icon?, disabled? }]. `icon` is a React node or a built-in icon name.
Controlled selection: a value, or an array of values in multiple mode. Leave undefined to let it keep its own.
Selected on first render when uncontrolled, and what a form reset returns to.

dataProps.type: (value: string | string[] | null, item: { value: string; title: node; description?: node; meta?: node; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean } | null) => void
dataProps.description: (value, item) => void; value is an array in multiple mode. On a form reset item is null.
Input name, so the selection is submitted with a <form> (one entry per ticked box in multiple mode).
The form will not submit until one card is chosen (at least one in multiple mode).
An error you already have, shown under the cards and announced; the inputs get aria-invalid.
Dim text after the legend. Defaults to "pick any" in multiple mode and nothing in single mode; pass "" to hide it.
Other attributes (aria-label when there is no legend, aria-describedby, data-*) go to the <fieldset>; className and style too.

Forwarded to the <fieldset> (measure it, scroll it into view). ref.current.focus() moves focus to the checked card (the first checked one in multiple mode), else the first enabled card; use it to send someone back to the group after a validation error. With every card disabled it does nothing.
Show each item's icon. Only items that have an `icon` draw one, so with no icons in `items` this has nothing to hide.
Show each item's `meta` line (a price, a duration).
Face of the meta line: "mono" (the default, for prices and figures) or "text" to set it in the body font.
